---
title: "01 - GlycA exposure instruments"
format: html
---

Exposure: `met-d-GlycA` (UK Biobank, Nightingale NMR, MRC-IEU pipeline, N = 115,078, SD units).
All later scripts read `data/processed/exp_dat.rds`, so one fixed instrument set is used throughout; re-running
stage A against a later OpenGWAS snapshot can change it.

```{r setup}
source("00_setup.R")
```

## Stage A - extract instruments (OpenGWAS token; runs only with GLYCA_RUN_EXTRACTION=1)

The token is read from the environment variable `OPENGWAS_JWT` (set in `.Renviron`, never in a script). The
OpenGWAS record of the exposure is saved to `logs/gwasinfo_met-d-GlycA.csv` to complete the exposure citation.

```{r extract}
if (RUN_EXTRACTION) {
  library(ieugwasr)
  write.csv(as.data.frame(gwasinfo("met-d-GlycA")), file.path(DIR$log, "gwasinfo_met-d-GlycA.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  exp_dat <- extract_instruments(outcomes = "met-d-GlycA",          # `outcomes` is TwoSampleMR's argument name for the source GWAS
                                 p1 = 5e-8, clump = TRUE, r2 = 0.001, kb = 10000)
  exp_dat$F <- (exp_dat$beta.exposure / exp_dat$se.exposure)^2
  saveRDS(exp_dat, file.path(DIR$proc, "exp_dat.rds"))
}
```

## Stage B - instrument summary (offline)

```{r summary}
exp_dat <- readRDS(need_file(file.path(DIR$proc, "exp_dat.rds"), "run stage A (needs the OpenGWAS token)"))
exp_dat$F  <- (exp_dat$beta.exposure / exp_dat$se.exposure)^2
exp_dat$r2 <- 2 * exp_dat$eaf.exposure * (1 - exp_dat$eaf.exposure) * exp_dat$beta.exposure^2
stopifnot(nrow(exp_dat) == 60, !anyDuplicated(exp_dat$SNP))         # frozen instrument set used in the manuscript

cat(sprintf("Instruments: %d | F: min %.1f, mean %.1f, max %.1f | variance explained: %.2f%%\n",
            nrow(exp_dat), min(exp_dat$F), mean(exp_dat$F), max(exp_dat$F), 100 * sum(exp_dat$r2)))
R2_tot   <- sum(exp_dat$r2)
F_joint  <- (R2_tot / (1 - R2_tot)) * (N_EXPOSURE - nrow(exp_dat) - 1) / nrow(exp_dat)       # joint F-statistic of the instrument set
cat(sprintf("Joint F-statistic: %.1f\n", F_joint))
top <- which.max(exp_dat$F)
cat(sprintf("Instruments with F < 30: %d | strongest: %s (F = %.1f, chr%s:%s)\n",
            sum(exp_dat$F < 30), exp_dat$SNP[top], exp_dat$F[top], exp_dat$chr.exposure[top], exp_dat$pos.exposure[top]))
```
